body.name: \(\mathbb P^{r}_{p,q}\)
body.space: probability laws on the sample space of \(O\)
body.def: Law of \(O=(X,A,R,Y^{\mathrm{obs}})\) induced by \(P_{p,q}\), \(R\mid(X=x,A=a)\sim\operatorname{Bernoulli}(r_{ax})\), annotation ignorability, and \(Y^{\mathrm{obs}}=Y\) if \(R=1\) and \(Y^{\mathrm{obs}}=\star\) otherwise.
